note: Recorded 2026-07-26 on an AWS c6id.2xlarge local-NVMe bench host (bench-infra, `make bench/autobench-median SAMPLES=15`) at git b48295e. Values are 15-sample medians; each tolerance_pct = max(10, ceil(1.5x the worst observed deviation from the median)), computed by scripts/baselines_from_samples.py. Raw samples: bench-infra/bench-out/dist/20260726T165243Z/autobench-samples/. NVMe-host values: `make perf/check` on the noisy virtualized sandbox WILL fail by design (different host shape, not a regression) — re-record locally with `make perf/baseline` if you need a sandbox gate. Tail metrics (read_p99_under_load_ns, apply_p99_ns, snapshot_freeze_p99_us) carry wide tolerances because the max-deviation rule is anti-robust on p99s.
